content.en_US:
5x5x6. Turns hot lead into dense core slurry and molten core mix. Draws 15,000,000 HE/t, takes 20 mB/t in, makes 10 + 5 mB/t out.

A core fissure must be somewhere directly below it, at any depth. Fissures only generate in the Nether at Y=0, in about 1% of chunks - the fissure block itself is unbreakable, so spot it by the deep rock pile on bedrock.

Slot 0 must hold a synthetic X crystal, which is not consumed. All three lamps must be green before it starts.

The input tank is fixed at 5 PU and only takes high-temperature lead at that pressure. Lower-pressure pipes cannot fill it, and there is no bucket slot.

Any full output tank stops the machine. All ports are on the top layer, facing up.

See also:
[[Ores and Mining|Addon Ores]]
[[Subcritical Nuclear Explosion Generator|Nuclear Explosion Generator]]
content.zh_CN:
使用高温铅和人造X晶体提取出地核中的原浆和混合物。

正下方任意高度必须有地核熔岩裂隙。裂隙只在下界 Y=0 生成, 约 1% 的区块。

必须常驻人造X晶体。三盏灯全绿才允许开机。

输入罐固定 5 PU, 只收同压的高温铅

另见:
[[矿物与采掘|Addon Ores]]
